Markets.title: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
Markets.summary: As of August 14, veteran investor Madhusudan Kela's 19-stock portfolio was valued at approximately Rs 2,665 crore. Performance among his holdings varied widely in 2026, with seven stocks rallying between 10% and 135%, while five declined by 15% to 30%.

Markets.title: Bitcoin near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and cancelled SEC meeting dampen crypto sentiment
Markets.summary: Bitcoin hovered near $63,000 as declining ETF demand and a cancelled SEC meeting weighed on the cryptocurrency market. Both Bitcoin and Ethereum saw decreases, causing the global crypto market capitalization to slip by 0.4%.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty consolidation to continue says Sudeep Shah; gives Tata Motors, Lenskart, Honasa strategy
Markets.summary: The Nifty is expected to remain range-bound with key support at 24,150–24,200 and resistance at 24,550–24,600 amid falling volatility. Analysts recommend specific strategies for Tata Motors, Lenskart, and Honasa while favoring PSU banks, auto, defense, and chemical sectors.

Markets.title: IPO rush: 5 companies to raise Rs 5,499 crore next week; Shiprocket, 4 others to list
Markets.summary: Five companies will raise Rs 5,499.32 crore through initial public offerings between August 17 and 21. Additionally, five recently completed IPOs, including Shiprocket, are scheduled to list next week.

Markets.title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
Markets.summary: The Sensex fell 490 points over a five-session period ending August 14, with 23 BSE 500 stocks declining during every session. Eleven of these stocks dropped by more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah, and Techno Electric & Engineering.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| Where is the value? Sachin Bajaj favours financials, healthcare, capex plays
Markets.summary: Axis Max Life CIO Sachin Bajaj is optimistic about Indian equities due to recovering earnings, moderate valuations, and strong domestic flows. He recommends investing in financials, healthcare, capital goods, digital platforms, and manufacturing, while avoiding expensive stocks.

Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers are searching for survivors following a powerful earthquake in Indonesia that destroyed hundreds of buildings. Officials report that the disaster has killed 47 people and a rapid assessment of the damage is underway.

Geo-Political.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: Moroccan security forces detained dozens of migrants attempting to cross the border into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The detentions occurred after social media posts suggested a second mass crossing attempt would take place on Saturday.

Geo-Political.summary: Eleven people were killed in southern Lebanon following Israeli airstrikes. The Israeli military stated the strikes targeted Hezbollah infrastructure after earlier action was taken against its soldiers.

Geo-Political.summary: Qatar has denied capturing three Iranian pilots who Iran claims were held after Qatari forces shot down two fighter jets. The alleged incident occurred at the start of the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation dipped slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the month.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion from a year earlier.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation eased to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase aligned with analyst expectations and could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated global oil prices continue to pose economic risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year, citing a robust economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment.

India.title: Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, Tiger Shroff Issued Notices By Tukaram Mundhe Over 'Vimal Elaichi' Ad
India.summary: Maharashtra food safety chief Tukaram Mundhe issued notices to Bollywood actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff. The notices concern the actors' indirect promotion of pan masala through 'Vimal Elaichi' advertisements.

India.title: Asish Banerjee, Mamata Banerjee's Close Aide, Found Dead At Trinamool Office
India.summary: Asish Banerjee, a close aide to Trinamool leader Mamata Banerjee and a five-time MLA, was found dead at a Trinamool office. He previously served as the deputy speaker of the West Bengal assembly.

India.title: After Cockroaches In Mumbai, Rat Found In Blinkit Ice Cream Freezer In Thane
India.summary: A rat was found inside a Blinkit ice cream freezer in Thane, Maharashtra. This incident follows a recent discovery of cockroaches in Mumbai and has increased scrutiny on quick-commerce food storage facilities by safety authorities.

India.title: Ties With India 'Valuable Asset': Iran President On 80th Independence Day
India.summary: Iranian President Pezeshkian extended his wishes to India on its 80th Independence Day. He described the deep historic ties between the two nations as a valuable asset.
